# attester

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attester`](gmeow-attester.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attester>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)

The agent that issued an attestation — the vouching party. Functional within the relator: one attester per [`Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) (co-authorship is modelled as multiple Attestations).
